    AI Overview
    Pooh Shiesty (Lontrell Williams) was released from federal prison on October 7, 2025, after serving approximately three years of a 63-month sentence for a firearms conspiracy charge. He was released early from USP Canaan in Pennsylvania for good behavior but returned to custody in early 2026 following a new arrest. 
    Key Details Regarding His Release and Re-arrest: 
    • Initial Release (Oct 2025): His attorney, Bradford Cohen, confirmed his release in October 2025 after he pleaded guilty to a firearms conspiracy charge related to a 2020 Florida incident.
    • Re-arrest (April 2026): According to reports in April 2026, Pooh Shiesty was arrested again following an FBI raid in Dallas, Texas, violating the terms of his previous release.
    • Original Sentence: He was originally sentenced in April 2022 to 5 years and 3 months (63 months) with a projected release date of April 2026, but his early release was cut short by the new 2026 charges.

    As of April 2026, rapper
    Pooh Shiesty (Lontrell Williams Jr.) is back in federal custody following his arrest in Dallas, Texas, for his alleged role as a "ringleader" in a kidnapping and robbery conspiracy. This arrest occurred just months after his October 2025 release from a 63-month federal prison sentence for a previous firearms conviction. 
    Key details regarding his situation: 
    • Recent Arrest: Pooh Shiesty was arrested in early April 2026 following an FBI raid on a Tennessee home affiliated with his family.
    • Charges: Prosecutors allege he was involved in a conspiracy to kidnap and rob victims in Dallas.
    • Previous Release:
      He had been released from a Pennsylvania federal prison in October 2025 after serving three years of his original sentence for a 2020 Florida shooting.
    • Violation: At the time of the alleged new offenses, he was reportedly on home confinement/supervised release from his prior conviction.
    • Status: He is currently detained in the Texas area pending further legal proceedings.
